newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank of China to increase working capital - agency.
newsitem.headline: Bank of China to increase working capital - agency.

text.p: The Bank of China decided on Tuesday to increase its working capital to 62 billion yuan by transfering 10 billion yuan from its accumulated fund, Beijing-backed Hong Kong-based China News Service reported.
The bank, China's international banking arm, had increased its net working capital to 52 billion in 1995, the news agency said.
It needed to expand its working capital to cope with its rapid business expansion and to bring it in line with domestic and international monetary control requirement, the report said.

The bank's net profit was 11.6 billion in 1996 while the aggregate value of its assets was over 2,100.07 billion yuan, including US$131 billion controlled by its overseas branches, the news agency said.
